designationHistory.indexText: The Fish and Wildlife Service bought 1,871 acres in Ventura County, California, in 1974 to establish the Hopper Mountain National Wildlife Refuge for the endangered California condor.

authority.citation: Fish and Wildlife Act of 1956 (land acquisition); Endangered Species Act of 1973
